## Change

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the checks appropriate to this change and their results.

## Publication review

- [ ] Files and release assets belong in the public project under the [publication policy](https://github.com/SmiCut/smiprog/blob/main/docs/publication-policy.md).
- [ ] No credentials, customer records, confidential commercial data or unapproved internal prototypes are included.
- [ ] Redistribution rights and required notices have been checked for third-party material.
- [ ] Calculation changes include matching references and examples; performance claims distinguish estimates from measured results.
